literal.prompt: Какая игра 2000 года о Джей-Си Дентоне сочетала ролевую систему, вид от первого лица и несколько способов решения задач?

literalGroups.primaryGround: Steam identifies the GOTY edition as released 22 June 2000 and describes first-person role-playing with multiple solutions (lines 24-32,117-125); Eidos identifies JC Denton and the RPG/multiple-solution design (lines 32-40). The joined clues uniquely identify Deus Ex among these four game titles.
literalGroups.locator: Steam lines 24-32 establish release 22 June 2000; 117-125 establish first-person role-playing and multiple solutions. Eidos lines 32-40 establish JC Denton, RPG framing and talk/fight/skills options.

literalGroups.literal: В Deus Ex можно было решать препятствия разговором, боем или навыками, подстраивая игру под свой стиль. Поэтому правильный ответ — Deus Ex.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Eidos explicitly says players can talk, fight, or use skills to pass obstacles and that the game adapts to their style (line 40); the proposed explanation states those exact source-backed approaches.
literalGroups.locator: Eidos lines 38-40: multiple problem solutions; talk, fight or use skills; play adapts to style. Steam lines 124-125 independently repeats those mechanics.

literalGroups.literal: Джей-Си Дентон — наномодифицированный агент Антитеррористической коалиции ООН.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Eidos directly identifies JC Denton as a nano-augmented agent of the United Nations Anti-Terrorist Coalition (line 32); the Russian wording preserves that relation.
literalGroups.locator: Eidos line 32: JC Denton is a nano-augmented agent of the United Nations Anti-Terrorist Coalition.

literalGroups.literal: Ico — мальчик и Ёрда пытаются выбраться из обширного древнего замка.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The full PlayStation retrospective describes the Ico player as alone with Yorda and trying to escape a vast, ancient castle (line 70); the note is a concise accurate summary.
literalGroups.locator: PlayStation.Blog Ico page line 70: Ico is described as the boy and Yorda trying to escape a vast, ancient castle.

literalGroups.literal: В Katamari Damacy игрок катит шар и собирает предметы.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Bandai Namco official site calls out ball-rolling and object-collecting as Katamari Damacy REROLL gameplay (line 27); the note summarizes those mechanics.
literalGroups.locator: Bandai Namco lines 23-27: Katamari Damacy REROLL has ball-rolling and object-collecting gameplay.

literalGroups.literal: В Shadow of the Colossus, чтобы спасти девушку, герой должен победить шестнадцать колоссов.
literalGroups.primaryGround: PlayStation’s official description says the way to save the girl is to slay sixteen Colossi (line 60); the note accurately summarizes that goal.
literalGroups.locator: PlayStation.Blog Shadow page line 60: to save the girl, slay sixteen Colossi.
